properties.name: pagbank.token
properties.description: API token from your PagBank dashboard. Required; the application fails to start without it.

properties.name: pagbank.environment
properties.description: Target PagBank environment. Production is only reached when spelled out explicitly.

properties.name: pagbank.base-url
properties.description: Absolute URL that overrides the environment's base URL - for example a local stub when testing.

properties.name: pagbank.health-indicator-enabled
properties.description: Exposes /actuator/health/pagBank when Spring Boot Actuator is on the classpath.

properties.name: pagbank.log-requests
properties.description: Logs outgoing requests and responses at DEBUG, with card data, CPF/CNPJ, e-mail and phone numbers masked.

properties.name: pagbank.connect-timeout
properties.description: How long to wait for the TCP connection to PagBank. 0 disables the timeout (waits forever). A request that times out while connecting never reached PagBank.

properties.name: pagbank.read-timeout
properties.description: How long to wait for PagBank's response once connected. 0 disables the timeout (waits forever). Keep it below the timeout of any proxy in front of the application so the starter fails first, with a typed exception.

properties.name: pagbank.webhook.verify-signature
properties.description: Requires a valid x-authenticity-token header on webhooks. Off by default because the Subscriptions API is not documented to send it.
